last_lineage_decision.reason: Experiment 8's fresh feasible-primary-input hypothesis is contradicted and its recipe is not competitive. On the fresh disjoint 2000-episode panel seed 27000 the retained working policy (experiment-2 checkpoint-100352) scored 1948/2000 = 97.40% (open-feasible 1888/1888 = 100%, folded-required 60/112 = 53.6%) while experiment-8 checkpoint-115712 scored 1898/2000 = 94.90% (folded 10/112 = 8.9%) and checkpoint-120832 scored 1892/2000 = 94.60% (folded 12/112 = 10.7%); working won both paired comparisons (54 vs 4 and 62 vs 6 discordant wins). The intervention is therefore actively harmful in the folded sector it targeted, including the shallow 170-174 degree band (100% -> 11-13%), and no experiment-8 checkpoint approaches the working lineage. Working remains the best measured policy at 6232/6400 = 97.375% pooled over eight distinct research panels, still below the 98% objective with all residual behavior in the folded-required sector, so terminal assessment is not justified. Development continues from working into a further ordinary experiment; the campaign proceeds rather than ending.
